commands.name: ban
commands.description: Removes a member from the server and prevents them from rejoining until they're unbanned.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to ban.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the ban, shown in the audit log and the DM sent to the user.

arguments.name: delete_messages
arguments.description: How many days of that user's recent messages to delete (0-7).

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Removes a member from the server. They can rejoin with a new invite.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to kick.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the kick, shown in the audit log.

commands.name: timeout
commands.description: Temporarily removes a member's ability to send messages, add reactions, or join voice channels.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to time out.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: How long the timeout lasts (e.g. 10m, 1h, 1d). Max 28 days.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the timeout, shown in the audit log.

commands.name: rank
commands.description: Shows a member's current level, XP progress, and server rank.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to check. Defaults to yourself.

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.description: Displays the server's top members ranked by XP.

arguments.name: page
arguments.description: Which page of the leaderboard to view.

commands.name: setlevel
commands.description: Manually sets a member's level, overriding their current XP.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member whose level you're changing.

arguments.name: level
arguments.description: The level to set them to.

commands.name: poll
commands.description: Posts a reaction-based poll that members can vote on.

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: The question being asked.

arguments.name: options
arguments.description: A comma-separated list of up to 10 answer choices.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: How long the poll stays open before results are posted.

commands.name: remind
commands.description: Sets a personal reminder that hollow. will DM you when it's time.

arguments.name: time
arguments.description: When to be reminded (e.g. 20m, 3h, 2d).

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: What to be reminded about.

commands.name: userinfo
commands.description: Looks up account details for a member: join date, account age, and roles.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to look up. Defaults to yourself.

commands.name: reactionrole
commands.description: Attaches a self-assignable role to an emoji reaction on an existing message.

arguments.name: message_id
arguments.description: The ID of the message to attach the reaction role to.

arguments.name: emoji
arguments.description: The emoji members react with to get the role.

arguments.name: role
arguments.description: The role to assign when that emoji is used.

commands.name: autorole
commands.description: Automatically assigns a role to every new member when they join the server.

arguments.name: role
arguments.description: The role to auto-assign on join.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.description: Turn auto-role on or off. Defaults to on.

commands.name: welcome
commands.description: Configures a welcome message posted automatically when a new member joins.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: The channel welcome messages should be posted in.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Custom message text. Supports {user} and {server} placeholders.
